description.zh: 连麦唯一标识。由字母、数字和短横线（-）组成，长度为36个字符。
description.en: The unique ID of the conference call. The value consists of letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and is 36 characters in length.

description.zh: 踢人者用户ID，在AppId下单独唯一。英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、短横线（-）、小数点（.）和@组成。长度为1到36个字符。
description.en: The ID of the user who initiates the removal. The ID must be unique within the AppId. The value consists of letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and at signs (@). The value must be 1 to 36 characters in length.

description.zh: 被踢者用户ID，在AppId下单独唯一。英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、短横线（-）、小数点（.）和@组成。长度为1到36个字符。
description.en: The ID of the user to be removed. The ID must be unique within the AppId. The value consists of letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and at signs (@). The value must be 1 to 36 characters in length.
